## Uniformity and Witness Scope
Write nested quantifiers in order before comparing choices: for each target, a witness may be chosen separately, whereas one witness required to work for every target is a different claim. For a supremum over dimensions and inputs, a uniform bound means one constant works for all of them; an infinite supremum means arbitrarily large ratios occur for some dimensions and inputs. Keep inequality direction explicit: lower examples establish growth, while upper bounds alone do not.
